edits.rationale: The design-context read the existing auditor gets wrong, verbatim so the color_palette-avoidance is checkable by eye.
edits.sketch: SELECT jsonb_build_object('design_intent', (SELECT ss.data FROM site_specs ss WHERE ss.site_id = $1::uuid AND ss.aspect = 'design_intent' AND ss.is_current), 'palette_name', p2.name, 'palette', p2.colours, 'style_collection', sc.name) AS design_context FROM sites s JOIN style_collections sc ON sc.id = s.style_collection_id JOIN css_themes ct ON ct.id = sc.css_theme_id JOIN palettes p2 ON p2.id = ct.palette_id WHERE s.id = $1::uuid
